entries.13420e576e44ea49: Revenue from franchise headquarters operations and related businesses. In Japan, Curves Japan, Inc. provides management guidance, systems, know-how, equipment, and products to franchisees; overseas, Curves International, Inc. manages royalties and sells equipment and other items to master franchisees in countries around the world. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥14,485 million.
entries.505e1689a6a25964: Revenue from merchandise sold to members. Curves Japan, Inc. handles merchandise sales to members and sells member merchandise such as "Curves Protein." Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥23,080 million.
entries.5adca1d819fcaff2: A holding company that operates "Curves", a 30-minute health fitness program for women only, as a franchise, and also sells products to its members.
entries.82468f1936f50f57: The company is a pure holding company that forms a group with seven consolidated subsidiaries and two non-consolidated subsidiaries, and its principal business is the Curves Business, which operates "Curves, the 30-minute women-only fitness club" and other services. The reportable segment consists solely of the Curves Business. As of the end of August 2025, the number of domestic stores was 1,996 and the number of members was 863,000; revenue for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥37,566 million.
